topic: 专项练习 - 关系代词与定语从句 (Relative Pronouns: who, which, that, whose, where, when)

questions.question: The kind teacher _______ taught us music last term has moved to another school.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The kind teacher'（人），从句中缺少主语，指代人作主语应用关系代词 who。

questions.question: My dad bought a special camera _______ can take clear pictures underwater.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'a special camera'（物品），从句中缺少主语，指代物应用关系代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: That is the boy _______ dog won the first prize in the pet show.
questions.explanation: 空格后有名词 'dog'，表示'那个小男孩的狗'，表示所属关系时必须使用关系代词 whose；who's 是 who is 或 who has 的缩写，不符合语法。

questions.question: This is the peaceful garden _______ we often read storybooks after class.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the peaceful garden'（地点），后面的句子 'we often read storybooks after class' 句子成分完整，需要关系副词 where 表示'在那个花园里'。

questions.question: The adventure novel _______ my sister recommended was really exciting.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The adventure novel'（物品），在从句中作宾语（recommended 的宾语），故选用 that 或 which。

questions.question: Do you know the girl _______ bicycle was stolen outside the supermarket?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the girl'，从句中修饰 bicycle，表示所有格'……的自行车'，应选用关系代词 whose。

questions.question: An astronomer is a scientist _______ studies stars, planets, and galaxies.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'a scientist'（指人），从句缺少主语，且指代人，故使用 who。

questions.question: We visited the town museum _______ many ancient coins are displayed.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点 'the town museum'，从句 'many ancient coins are displayed' 结构完整，需要地点状语，故选用关系副词 where。

questions.question: We visited the town museum _______ has the largest collection of dinosaur bones.
questions.explanation: 先行词虽然也是地点 'the town museum'，但从句中缺少主语（缺少 has 的主语），指代物作主语应用 which 或 that，不能用 where。

questions.question: I made friends with Leo, _______ father is a pilot for a major airline.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 Leo，空格修饰 father，表示'Leo 的父亲'，属于所有格关系，应用 whose。

questions.question: Autumn is the colourful season _______ the leaves turn red, orange, and yellow.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the colourful season'（时间），从句结构完整，缺少时间状语，故用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The baker _______ baked these delicious chocolate muffins won a gold medal.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The baker'（面包师，人），从句缺少主语，应用关系代词 who。

questions.question: A penguin is a flightless bird _______ lives mostly in the Southern Hemisphere.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'a flightless bird'（动物/物），从句中缺少主语，指动物通常用 which 或 that。

questions.question: Look at that old house _______ roof is painted bright green.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'that old house'，空格后是名词 roof，whose 既可指人也可指物的所有格，表示'屋顶漆成绿色的那栋老房子'。

questions.question: The students _______ volunteered to clean the school playground worked very hard.
questions.explanation: 先行词是复数名词 'The students'（人），从句缺少主语，应用 who。

questions.question: This is the seaside cottage _______ my grandparents spend their summer holidays.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the seaside cottage'（海边小屋，地点），从句 'my grandparents spend their summer holidays' 主谓宾齐全，需要地点副词 where（相当于 in which）。

questions.question: Can you recommend an Italian restaurant _______ serves authentic thin-crust pizza?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'an Italian restaurant'，从句缺少动词 serves 的主语，因此要用关系代词 that 或 which，不能用 where。

questions.question: I can't find the silver watch _______ my grandfather gave me for my birthday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the silver watch'（物），在从句中作 gave 的直接宾语，指物应用 which 或 that。

questions.question: The author _______ fantasy novels are popular among kids visited our library.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The author'，从句中修饰 fantasy novels，表示'该作者的奇幻小说'，表示所属关系用 whose。

questions.question: The nurse _______ took my temperature was extremely gentle and polite.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The nurse'（护士，人），从句缺少主语，故使用 who。

questions.question: Do you remember the day _______ our whole class went to the science centre?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the day'（时间），从句结构完整，引导时间状语从句应用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The robot _______ won the competition was built by three fifth-grade pupils.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The robot'（机器人，非人/物），从句中作主语，应用 which 或 that。

questions.question: A girl _______ art project received the principal's award was smiling proudly.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'A girl'，空格修饰 art project，指'那个女孩的艺术作品'，属于所有格关系，选 whose。

questions.question: The laboratory _______ the students do chemistry experiments is on the third floor.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The laboratory'（实验室，地点），从句 'the students do chemistry experiments' 成分完整，缺少地点状语（in the laboratory），因此选 where。

questions.question: The soccer coach _______ trains our school team used to be a professional player.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The soccer coach'（教练，人），从句缺少动词 trains 的主语，用 who。

questions.question: Please board the yellow bus _______ stops directly in front of the sports stadium.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the yellow bus'（交通工具，物），从句缺少主语，选项中 that 可以代替物作定语从句的主语。

questions.question: The peacock is a splendid bird _______ feathers display a magnificent pattern of eyes.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'a splendid bird'（孔雀，动物），从句修饰 feathers，表示'孔雀的羽毛'，物或动物的所有格用 whose。

questions.question: That is the quiet room in the library _______ students must keep their voices down.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'the quiet room'（地点），从句主干完整（students must keep their voices down），需要在该地点发生的动作，故选关系副词 where。

questions.question: The volunteers _______ helped plant fifty new trees in the park were given certificates.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'The volunteers'（志愿者，人），从句缺少主语，指代人作主语用 who。

questions.question: An electric car is a modern vehicle _______ produces zero exhaust fumes while driving.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 'a modern vehicle'（车辆，物），从句缺少主语，指代事物作主语应用 which 或 that。
